description: This PHP class 'JobTitleModel' serves as an API data representation for the 'JobTitle' entity in the OrangeHRM system. It includes API schema annotations for OpenAPI specification, utilizing traits for serialization, and sets up filters and attribute mappings related to the job title and its associated job specification attachment.

classes.name: JobTitleModel
classes.description: API model class representing a Job Title with associated specifications, utilizing annotations for API schema validation and serialization traits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the JobTitleModel with a JobTitle entity, setting filters and attribute mappings for serialization and API output.
